title: Relative Sort Array

interface_proposal.authority: local catalogue convention; not claimed official runtime signature

result.semantics: Return the arr1 multiset grouped by arr2 value order, followed by values absent from arr2 in ascending order.

local_policy_proposal.effects: Freeze input-preservation and returned-alias policy independently before qualification; mathematical modifications are not automatically caller-visible effects.
local_policy_proposal.transport: JSON values; integer parameters exclude booleans; real values must be finite.

boundary_plan: Length 1000 with repeated priorities and residual values at 0 and 1000.
promotion_gate: Independent clause/interface/effect review plus new source/runtime/test-bound receipts. Never upgrade compatibility-only probes or historical admitted evidence.
